could someone explain (in no more than 5 sentences) why the API is so bad at the moment, and what v2 will do better?

The current API only allows you to request existing data, and doesn't provide any way of letting a user login/update content.

The new API allows you to create, update, & delete content, all while logged in to an account. It also provides a bunch of options like sorting subverses, and caters towards bots that need to constantly scan a subverse for new submissions. Basically the new API provides way more options and is nicer to use from a technical perspective, I hope that helps.
